item.title: A handshake but no smile, is this the best that Takaichi can hope for in China?
item.description: In Beijing’s diplomatic protocols, choreography can carry the same weight as a communique. When Chinese President Xi Jinping takes his place at the end of the red carpet to welcome visitors to the Apec summit on Thursday, many eyes will be on his brief encounter with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi. item.title: Singapore will be Asean chair. What’s its biggest challenge?
item.description: As the Philippines handed over Asean’s chairmanship gavel to Singapore on Tuesday, analysts expect the city state to make progress on digital economic integration, AI governance and trade expansion as the bloc marks its 60th anniversary in 2027. But Singapore will face a tougher task in tackling perennial unresolved issues, such as the South China Sea code of conduct (COC) and the humanitarian crisis in Myanmar, where analysts see limited prospects for breakthroughs. item.title: Abby Choi’s ex-father-in-law tells court he put HK$30m towards purchase of luxury flat
item.description: The former father-in-law of slain Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung has denied seeking financial support from her and claimed that he contributed HK$30 million to the purchase of a luxury home at the centre of a bitter dispute between their two families. item.title: Ukraine damages Russia’s Crimean bridge in major strike
item.description: Ukrainian drones and missiles destroyed the central road section of the bridge linking Russia and Crimea on Tuesday, inflicting a military and symbolic blow on President Vladimir Putin two days before he is due to meet the leaders of China and the United States. item.title: Hong Kong partners with Qingdao port as think tank urges maritime resilience
item.description: Hong Kong has established a port partnership with Qingdao in mainland China as part of efforts to broaden international collaboration on shipping logistics, smart ports and green corridors. The news of the partnership came as local think tank Our Hong Kong Foundation said that the city should prepare the sector to withstand geopolitical shocks by developing marine insurance and maritime arbitration.
